newsitem.title: LIECHTENSTEIN: SOCCER-LIECHTENSTEIN WITHOUT ONLY FULL-TIMER FOR CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIECHTENSTEIN WITHOUT ONLY FULL-TIMER FOR CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: The part-timers from Liechtenstein will be without their only professional player for Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Macedonia.
Mario Frick, a midfielder with Basle in the Swiss first divison and Liechtenstein's only full-time player, will miss the match after picking up a second yellow in last month's 2-1 loss to Lithuania.
Returning to the 18-man squad, named by coach Erich Buerzle on Monday, is Ralf Oehri who missed the Lithuania match because was unable to get time off work.
The Liechtensteiner's will be out to avenge a 3-0 loss to the Macedonians in what was their first appearance in World Cup competition on April 24.
Defenders - Thomas Hanselmann (Balzers), Roland Hilti (Schaan), Juergen Ospelt (Eschen), Martin Stocklasa (Eschen), Daniel Telser (Balzers).

Midfielders - Daniel Hasler (Vaduz), Steffan Hassler (Eschen), Patrik Marxer (Eschen), Ralf Oehri (Balzers), Alex Quaderer (Vaduz), Franz Schaedler (Triesenberg), Martin Telser (Balzers), Harry Zech (Vaduz).
Forwards - Alexander Schaedler (Eschen), Philipp Beck (Eschen), Herbert Bicker (Schaan).
